name: Booktabs table
description: A clean, publication-style table: no vertical lines, proper rule spacing, caption above.
notes: No vertical lines. booktabs rules look wrong with `|` columns.
`@{}` at both ends removes the outer padding so the rules line up with the text.
Put the `\caption` **above** a table and **below** a figure (the usual convention).
`\label` must come *after* `\caption`, otherwise `\ref` points at the section number.
